rationale: Eight TRIP-derived hotspot candidates were experimentally retargeted by CRISPR/HDR and master host cell lines had verified on-target single-copy landing-pad integrations.
All eight retargeted sites supported transgene mRNA expression equal to or higher than the Fer1l4 industrial comparator in equivalent conditions.
The retargeting experiment did not establish locus-specific longitudinal stability for every individual hotspot; the longitudinal 72-PDL measurements belong to the upstream TRIP screen.
Exact mapping information could not be recovered reliably from accessible machine-readable supplementary/patent material; no genomic coordinate is inferred from gene name alone.
Positive observations without a reliable canonical physical coordinate remain outside benchmark_loci.tsv and benchmark_gold_binary.tsv.
